name: Volume-Adaptive Active Interface Model
aliases: Active Contour Model for Volume Fractions
Adaptive Laplacian Smoothing with Volume Constraints
definition: A method to reconstruct piecewise linear material interfaces from volume fraction data by iteratively updating control points using a balance of internal smoothing forces and external volume-adaptive forces to match known material volumes.
summary: The Volume-Adaptive Active Interface Model reconstructs piecewise linear material interfaces from volume fraction data by balancing Laplacian smoothing with volume-adaptive forces to prevent shrinkage artifacts.
